# GreatOhm

> GreatOhm is a Vedic-life-guidance app that brings Vedic astrology, numerology, Vaastu Shastra, palmistry, tarot, Vedic calendar information, Nakshatra analysis, and related tools together in one account, with a daily composite indicator called the Ohm Score and curated remedy/product recommendations.

GreatOhm is a product of GREATOHM (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED. The app is available on Google Play; an App Store version is planned. Users provide profile inputs once (date, time and place of birth with timezone handling, name, phone/country) and the app reuses them across reports, charts, and predictions. Outputs can be exported as PDF reports where provided. The app ships in-app translations for 26 locales.

## Services at a Glance

- **Astrology** — Daily/weekly/monthly/yearly horoscopes, Lal Kitab remedies, kundli and birth chart, Vedic astrology, kundli matching (Ashtakoota), Talk to Pandit Ji, WhatsApp horoscope alerts, Shubh Mahurat finder, problems & solutions, astrology PDF report, Nakshatra finder, Mangal Dosha / Kaal Sarp Dosha check, Sade Sati, Western natal chart, Moon phases, daily panchang, wealth probability, travel shoola, shoola muhurta, shoola chakra, shoola dasa, and register-as-expert.
- **Oracle & Divination** — Lenormand cards, angel numbers, Elder Futhark runes, Baralho Cigano, BaZi (Four Pillars), Ifa oracle, and I-Ching.
- **Numerology** — Numerology dashboard, life path & cycles, partner compatibility, name numerology, mobile number numerology, Lo Shu Grid, foreign settlement, profession suitability, business card analysis, lucky colours & months, numerology PDF report, Talk to Numerology Expert, suitable mobile number generation, personal cycle, super name generator, bank account number check, and flat number check.
- **Vaastu Shastra** — Residential Vaastu, commercial Vaastu, Talk to Vaastu Expert, auspicious build, map conversion, directions vs colour guide, Vaastu dosha rectification, and house plan library.
- **Palmistry** — AI palm reading, Talk to Palmist, palm lines deep dive, palm career reading, palm partner compatibility, palm wellness insights, and palm elements.
- **Tarot** — Tarot card reading, Talk to Tarot Expert, tarot love spread, tarot career spread, Celtic Cross, and tarot yes/no.
- **Vedic Calendar** — Tithis, planetary events, holidays, Grahan Darshan (eclipses with Sutak), and events.
- **Nakshatra** — Nakshatra profile, dasha, transit, and compatibility.
- **Past Memories & Games** — Moon Locator, expert chat history, FLAMES game, GreatOhm VIP Circle, and good-to-have remedies.
- **GreatOhm Club** — Membership applications, openings, translator roles and content contributions.
- **GreatOhm AI** — Dream interpretation, Ask GreatOhm AI chat, AI palm reading, AI business card analysis, and AI Vaastu map analysis.

## Cross-cutting Capabilities

- Live expert consultations (voice, video, chat) with masked calling and appointment booking.
- Recommendations and Great Remedies engine driven by Ohm Score weak-area pointers.
- Horoscope generation with push notifications and WhatsApp delivery.
- Learn With Us resources, moderated community groups, support tickets and feature suggestions.
- Ohm Tokens, wallet, cart, orders, pricing plans, subscriptions, invoices and refunds.
